text: Tell me about yourself.
Walk me through your resume.
Why did you choose your field of study?
What are your greatest strengths?
What do you enjoy doing outside of your studies or work?
What was your favourite subject in college, and why?
Why are you interested in this role?
What do you know about our company?
Are you willing to relocate for this job?
How do you keep yourself updated with what is happening in your field?
Which achievement from your college life are you most proud of?
How would your friends describe you?
What motivates you to do your best work?
What kind of work environment helps you do your best?
Tell me about a project you enjoyed working on.
How do you manage your time during exams or busy periods?
Are you comfortable working in shifts or on weekends when a project needs it?
What is your biggest weakness, and what are you doing about it?
Why should we hire you over other freshers with similar degrees?
Where do you see yourself in five years?
There is a gap or low score in your academic record. How would you explain it?
What are your salary expectations for this role?
What would you do if you were assigned to a technology or domain you have never worked with?
If you have other offers, how will you decide between them?
What does success mean to you in your first year of work?
What have you learned from your internship or part-time experience?
Your background is in a different branch. Why are you moving towards this role?
What is one piece of critical feedback you have received, and what did you do with it?
What skill are you actively trying to improve right now?
How do you prefer to be managed?
What would you do in your first 30 days in this job?
Would you be comfortable signing a service agreement with the company? Why or why not?
What kinds of tasks do you find boring, and how do you handle them?
Why are you interested in working at a company of our size?
You seem overqualified in some areas and underprepared in others for this role. Convince me you are the right fit.
Tell me about a decision in your career or education that you regret.
If you joined us and left after one year, what would be the most likely reason?
What is a popular opinion in your field that you disagree with?
Your manager asks you to do something you believe is unethical, such as altering a report. What do you do?
Why do you want to work here rather than at our closest competitor?
You receive our offer, then a better offer arrives a week before joining. What do you do?
What do you think is the biggest challenge facing our industry in the next few years?
Tell me something that is not on your resume that would change how I see you.
If I called your last mentor or professor, what would they say you need to work on?
How would you respond if your manager publicly criticised your work in a team meeting?
You are offered less than you expected. How would you negotiate as a fresher?
Describe the worst team or manager you could imagine working with. How would you cope?
You have no direct experience in this role. What evidence can you give that you will succeed?
What would you do if you realised after three months that this job was not what you expected?
If you could change one thing about how you spent your college years, what would it be and why?
